title: Draft the November club newsletter from notes and the season report
brief: Goal: a first draft of the Harbor Rowing Club November newsletter, about 300 words, in the owner's voice (friendly, plain, signed "Sam"). Sources: ~/Documents/Writing/club-notes.md, ~/Documents/Writing/season-report.pdf, and the league calendar at https://league.example/calendar for race dates. Constraints: only facts from these sources; no names beyond those in the notes. Done: a Markdown draft saved to the Library, with the numbers it uses listed and sourced.

input.content:
# Harbor Rowing Club, November 2026

Hi everyone,

October was our busiest month on the water this year. We logged 412 outings, up from 351 in September, and the novice eight finished its first full 5 km piece without stopping.

## Season in numbers

- 38 active members, 6 of them new this fall
- 2 regattas: 3rd place at the Head of the Lagoon, 5th at the Coastal Sprints
- The new launch is in service; the old one is up for sale

## What's coming

- Fall cleanup day: Saturday, Nov 7, 9 am at the boathouse. Bring gloves.
- Winter schedule starts Monday, Nov 16: weekday rows move to 7 am.
- The league's Turkey Head race is Saturday, Nov 28. Sign-ups close Nov 20.

## From the board

Dues for the winter term are the same as last year. The board meets again on Nov 12; send agenda items to Priya before then.

See you on the water,
Sam
